result:
All 617 existing tests pass, and typecheck is clean. The implementation is complete:

- `src/schemas/issue-import.ts` — new `importIssueRowSchema`/`importIssuesSchema`.
- `src/types/issue.ts` — `IssueImportResult`.
- `src/types/event.ts` — `issues.imported` event; `src/types/activity.ts` — matching `ActivityAction`.
- `src/server/services/issue-service.ts` — `importIssues`: permission/tenant/archived gates first, then replay lookup, then the batch-wide quota and rate-limit checks, then assignee/label resolution, sequential numbering, and a single `issues.imported` emit.
- New persistence: `src/server/db/schema/issue-imports.ts` (+ barrel export, + `migrate.ts` fallback DDL) and `src/server/repositories/issue-import-repository.ts` for replay durability across restarts.
- Repository additions: `issueRepository.findIssuesByIds` (order-preserving), `memberRepository.findActiveMemberUserIdByEmail` (case-insensitive, active only), `labelRepository.findLabelByName` (case-sensitive).
- Wired the new event into `activity-service.ts` (one audit row, action `issues.imported`), `usage-service.ts` (issues-used meter bump), and `search-service.ts` (indexes each imported issue) — deliberately left untouched in `webhook-service.ts`/`notification-service.ts` so imports don't trigger webhooks or notifications.
- Fixed a now-exhaustive `Record<ActivityAction, string>` in `activity-labels.ts`.
